label: Some single admitted quality has n pairwise numerically distinct Forms…, by… (2)
meaning: Starting from two ordinary F-particulars, form the next common Form over the old Forms plus that pair. Participant-wide nonidentity makes the new Form different from every earlier one; ordinary self-predication preserves homogeneity and explicit domain iteration preserves eligibility. Induction yields arbitrary finite lengths for one quality. No infinity premise and no opaque bridge to the conclusion is used.
